lineage.source: Synthetic three concentric rings, not real-world quality evidence.

quality_policy.partition: Fixed disjoint 540 training / 180 validation IDs; synthetic observations; no TEST.

G10.inconclusive_rule: Synthetic adaptive validation does not establish confirmatory or real-project performance.

metric_definitions.accuracy: Correct fixed-validation predictions divided by count.
metric_definitions.mean_iou: Equal mean of three class TP/(TP+FP+FN), zero denominator contributes zero.

data.description: 720 independent synthetic two-coordinate observations across three concentric rings.

quality_policy.partition: fixed per-class disjoint rows; no TEST

not_applicable_contracts.G04: Synthetic dimensionless features make no spatial reference-frame or vehicle geometry claim.
not_applicable_contracts.G05: No physical sensor calibration, projection or calibration-dependent target is used in this synthetic task.
not_applicable_contracts.G06: Independent synthetic observations contain no cross-sensor timestamps or synchronization requirement.
not_applicable_contracts.G11: This bounded engineering acceptance does not claim robustness; such claims need their own protocol.
not_applicable_contracts.G12: No model deployment, device timing, production health or service qualification is claimed.
